goal: Operator-locked P0: maximize artifact-backed useful-work duty cycle. Normal nonterminal turns target at least 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds); ACTUAL END + 1 minute (60 seconds) is the aggressive continuation target, not a requirement for exact provider dispatch.

active_interventions.expected_effect: Prevent voluntary normal CONTINUE close before 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds).
Distinguish local live-verified schedule mutation from provider execution/jitter and natural hourly cold fallback.
Eliminate ambiguous unitless timing arithmetic from human-readable control surfaces.
Prevent measurement blackout without backfilling unknown time.
Reject incomplete/inferred windows and unknown-time inflation.
Accept harmless early/late scheduler jitter immediately when single authority can be preserved; fence only real overlap/stale-authority hazards.
Every nonterminal wake ends with one final SAME MAIN full-VEVENT RRULE update to close + 1 minute (60 seconds); no later schedule mutation in that wake may overwrite it.
Separate execution evidence from host UI delivery. Persist every qualifying unit trace durably; emit immediately only when supported, otherwise flush ordered traces in the turn completion response.
